// diagnostic

E0941

The `~` copy sigil is retired; a copy is the method `x.copy()`

What

The `~` copy sigil is retired; a copy is the method `x.copy()`

Why

Jet has exactly one spelling for a deliberate copy, the built-in method `.copy()` (D-COPY-WORD1), so a copy reads as a word and chains like any method

Fix

Write `x.copy()`; `jet fix` applies this edit.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0941: tests/ui/retired_copy_sigil.stderr.

Error [E0941]: The `~` copy sigil is retired; a copy is the method `x.copy()`
  --> tests/ui/retired_copy_sigil.jet:3:15
    |
  3 |     copied :: ~name
    |               ^
 Why: Jet has exactly one spelling for a deliberate copy, the built-in method `.copy()` (D-COPY-WORD1), so a copy reads as a word and chains like any method
 Fix: Write `name.copy()`
